title: Third-party cyber evaluations involving OpenAI models
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: OpenAI explains recent third-party cybersecurity evaluation incidents and outlines new safeguards to strengthen AI model testing and evaluation.
body:
### Enhanced Security for AI Models
OpenAI has recently addressed concerns surrounding third-party cybersecurity evaluations involving their models. The company has outlined new measures to bolster the testing and evaluation of their AI models, ensuring a more secure experience for users. This move aims to strengthen the overall security posture of OpenAI's models, providing an additional layer of protection against potential threats.

### Strengthening Model Testing
The new safeguards introduced by OpenAI are designed to enhance the testing and evaluation process for their AI models. By implementing these measures, the company can better identify and mitigate potential security risks associated with third-party evaluations. This proactive approach demonstrates OpenAI's commitment to prioritizing the security and integrity of their models, ultimately benefiting developers and researchers who rely on these technologies.

### Impact on Developers and Researchers
The introduction of these new safeguards is significant for developers and researchers, as it provides them with a more secure foundation for building and testing AI-powered applications. By minimizing the risk of security breaches and data compromises, OpenAI's enhanced testing and evaluation protocols can foster a more trustworthy and collaborative environment for innovation, driving further advancements in the field of artificial intelligence.
